title: Enlarged etale ringed-site models of algebraic spaces
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $X$ be an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], with sites chosen small relative to the universe of sheaves as in [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal C_X$ have as objects etale morphisms $T\to X$ from algebraic spaces over $S$, as morphisms the maps over $X$, and as coverings the jointly surjective etale families [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Restriction along the inclusion $X_{\mathrm{et}}\hookrightarrow\mathcal C_X$ of scheme objects is an equivalence of sheaf topoi. A sheaf $F$ on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ has an extension $\widetilde F$ to $\mathcal C_X$, unique up to unique isomorphism restricting to the identity on $F$; for a surjective etale scheme chart $T_0\to T$, its sections are the equalizer $\widetilde F(T)=\operatorname{Eq}(F(T_0)\rightrightarrows F(T_0\times_TT_0))$ [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers], naturally in $T$ and $F$. This extends the structure sheaf and gives an equivalence of categories of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] for $\mathcal O_X$ and its extension $\widetilde{\mathcal O}_X$. For every morphism $f:X\to Y$ of algebraic spaces over $S$, the functor $v_f:\mathcal C_Y\to\mathcal C_X$, $V\mapsto X\times_YV$, is continuous and defines the small etale morphism of topoi under these equivalences. With the ring map induced on scheme charts by pullback of regular functions, this is the canonical morphism of ringed topoi for $f$; these constructions are compatible with composition. For every etale morphism $u:Z'\to Z$ of algebraic spaces over $S$, postcomposition identifies $\mathcal C_{Z'}$ with the localized site $\mathcal C_Z/Z'$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], with the same coverings, and identifies $\widetilde{\mathcal O}_{Z'}$ with $\widetilde{\mathcal O}_Z|_{Z'}$. Under these identifications the morphism of ringed topoi for $u$ is the localization morphism.
